definitions.explanation: The first coat of paint or finish applied to a surface before the main coat. Prepares the surface for better adhesion and appearance of the final coat.

examples.japanese: まず{下塗|したぬ}りをする。
{下塗|したぬ}りが{乾|かわ}いてから{上塗|うわぬ}りをしてください。
examples.english: Please apply the top coat after the undercoat has dried.

examples.japanese: {下塗|したぬ}りをしっかりやらないと、{仕上|しあ}がりが{悪|わる}くなる。
examples.english: If you don't do the undercoat properly, the finish will turn out poorly.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in painting (walls, furniture, art) and finishing work. The three stages of painting are typically {下塗|したぬ}り (undercoat), {中塗|なかぬ}り (middle coat), and {上塗|うわぬ}り (top coat).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下塗|したぬ}りをする (to apply an undercoat)
- {下塗|したぬ}り{材|ざい} (primer material)
- {下塗|したぬ}り{剤|ざい} (primer agent)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上塗|うわぬ}り: top coat, finish coat — the final layer
- プライマー: primer (loanword) — same meaning in technical contexts
